summary: This experimental memo describes ways to reduce the delay when a Mobile IPv6 device moves from one access router to another. That delay can cause packet loss, so the protocol helps the device prepare for the move. It was replaced by RFC 5268.

eli5.summary: When you move between rooms, there is a short gap with no signal. This protocol tries to make the switch smooth. It was later replaced by RFC 5268.

questions: how to reduce mobile ipv6 handover delay
